description.text: This program is designed to bring up senior specialized financial talents who possess good basic knowledge and financial theories, methods and application skills of modern finance. Graduates should be qualified for positions of research and management in relevant departments of financial firms, bank, securities, insurance and other institutions. Students would also been exposed to China's politics, economy and culture so that they could participate in and contribute to friendly exchanges and cooperation between China and their home countries. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Finance at Tongji University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3416 USD/per year ￥ 24600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate, non-Chinese citizen 2. with Old HSK Band 3 or New HSK Band 4 for Medicine, Science and Engineering, Original certificate of Old HSK Band 6 or New HSK Band 5 (Total Score: over 180) for the program of Liberal Arts
